before.content:
corepack pnpm --offline --filter @ji/web-app test
corepack pnpm --offline --filter @ji/web-app build
corepack pnpm --offline --filter @ji/web-app test:e2e
log=$(mktemp)
./gradlew :ji-host-web:runStage1HostFixture --offline >"$log" 2>&1 &
host_pid=$!
trap 'kill "$host_pid" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -f "$log"' EXIT INT TERM
i=0
until line=$(grep 'STAGE1_HOST_READY ' "$log" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1) && [ -n "$line" ]; do
  kill -0 "$host_pid" 2>/dev/null || { cat "$log" >&2; exit 1; }
  i=$((i + 1)); [ "$i" -lt 300 ] || { cat "$log" >&2; exit 1; }
  sleep 0.1
done
JI_STAGE1_TOKEN=[REDACTED_CREDENTIAL] corepack pnpm --offline --filter @ji/web-app test:e2e:real-host
kill "$host_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
wait "$host_pid" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -f "$log"
trap - EXIT INT TERM
pwsh -NoProfile -File ./scripts/verify-stage1-consumer.ps1

after.content:
corepack pnpm --offline --filter @ji/web-app test
corepack pnpm --offline --filter @ji/web-app build
corepack pnpm --offline --filter @ji/web-app test:e2e
node ./scripts/run-stage1-real-host.mjs
pwsh -NoProfile -File ./scripts/verify-stage1-consumer.ps1
